span.p:
refer: read the bytes back
from the owning system

div.style: color: rgb(28, 43, 58) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SOURCES own the content
git dirs · url: pages
(never copied into the index)

div.style: color: rgb(58, 42, 8) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
THE COMMITTED INDEX owns findability
.fux/index — 256 JSONL shards
term hashes · tf per field · flen · sha · edges
deterministic, byte-identical (L3)

div.style: color: rgb(18, 48, 28) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
THE DERIVED PLANE owns speed
.fux/runtime — gitignored, rebuildable
T1 accelerator · graph.json · caches

div.style: color: rgb(43, 22, 56) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
THE ANSWER PATH owns truth
rank in the index → fetch the cited docs
→ verify sha → re-score passages → cite
